answer: Here is a specific defense: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The vertex of work and the shale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a whisper to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
